description: Find a US or Canadian business's phone number, address, whether it's open now, today's hours, local time and rating. Pass near (city and state or province, or a zip or postal code); without it results can be anywhere in the US. No account needed. Also finds CallForMe's free fictional demo lines by name (demo: true, cost "Free"), e.g. query "Maple Street Pizza" or "demo". Example: find_business(query="brake repair", near="Plano, TX").

near.description: City and state or province, neighborhood, zip or postal code, or address

query.description: A name or type, e.g. "auto repair", "Nonna's Trattoria", "CVS pharmacy"

name: find_business
title: Find a business
